title: Y2k's Clean Hitboxes
description:
Y2k's Clean Hitboxes — a simple mod for PvP, anarchy servers, and clean screens.
Default Minecraft hitboxes (F3 + B) are messy — full of blue arrows and green lines.
body:
ENG///
Y2k's Clean Hitboxes is a simple and useful utility mod for anyone who loves PvP, plays on anarchy servers, or just wants a clean screen without annoying visual clutter.Default Minecraft hitboxes (F3 + B) completely mess up your screen with those blue look vectors and green eye-height lines. This mod removes all that useless stuff, leaving only a clean box around players and mobs.Features:Clean White Hitboxes: Instead of the default rainbow lines, you get a solid white outline that is perfectly visible on any block.Red on Hit: When you hit a target, its hitbox instantly flashes bright red for a split second. You will always know exactly if your hit registered or not.No Visual Trash: No blue look lines, no green eye lines. Just a completely clean view during intense fights.The mod is 100% client-side. This means you can safely use it on any multiplayer server, you won't get banned, and it doesn't need to be installed on the server side.
